arxiv-2105-00188.title: ℓ ​ r \ell r -Multisemigroups and Modal Convolution Algebras
arxiv-2105-00188.creator: Uli Fahrenberg, Christian Johansen, Georg Struth, Krzysztof Ziemiański
arxiv-2105-00188.description: Abstract We show how modal quantales arise as convolution algebras Q X Q^{X} of functions from ℓ ​ r \ell r -multisemigroups X X , that is, multisemigroups with a source map ℓ \ell and a target map r r , into modal quantales Q Q , which can be seen as weight or value algebras.

arxiv-2109-05767.title: Computation Rate Maximum for Mobile Terminals in UAV-assisted Wireless Powered MEC Networks with Fairness Constraint
arxiv-2109-05767.creator: Xiaoyi Zhou, Liang Huang, Tong Ye, Weiqiang Sun
arxiv-2109-05767.description: Abstract This paper investigates an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-assisted wireless powered mobile-edge computing (MEC) system, where the UAV powers the mobile terminals by wireless power transfer (WPT) and provides computation service for them. We aim to maximize the computation rate of terminals while ensuring fairness among them.

arxiv-2111-02354.title: Smooth Imitation Learning via Smooth Costs and Smooth Policies
arxiv-2111-02354.creator: Sapana Chaudhary, Balaraman Ravindran
arxiv-2111-02354.description: Abstract . Imitation learning (IL) is a popular approach in the continuous control setting as among other reasons it circumvents the problems of reward mis-specification and exploration in reinforcement learning (RL). In IL from demonstrations, an important challenge is to obtain agent policies that are smooth with respect to the inputs.

arxiv-2205-11826.title: Lack of Fluency is Hurting Your Translation Model
arxiv-2205-11826.creator: Jaehyo Yoo, Jaewoo Kang
arxiv-2205-11826.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jaehyo Yoo, Jaewoo Kang. Many machine translation models are trained on bilingual corpus, which consist of aligned sentence pairs from two different languages with same semantic. However, there is a qualitative discrepancy between train and test set in bilingual corpus. While the most train sentences are created via automatic techniques such as crawling and sentence-alignment methods, the test sentences are annotated with the consideration of fluency by human. We suppose this discrepancy in training corpus will yield performance drop of translation model.

arxiv-2308-10911.title: Crucial Feature Capture and Discrimination for Limited Training Data SAR ATR Thanks: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China under Grants 61901091 and 61901090. Thanks: Corresponding author: Jifang Pei. Thanks: The authors are with the Department of Electrical Eng
arxiv-2308-10911.creator: Chenwei Wang, Siyi Luo, Jifang Pei
arxiv-2308-10911.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Chenwei Wang, Siyi Luo, Jifang Pei. Although deep learning-based methods have achieved excellent performance on SAR ATR, the fact that it is difficult to acquire and label a lot of SAR images makes these methods, which originally performed well, perform weakly.

arxiv-2309-06618.title: Multi-dimensional Fusion and Consistency for Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2309-06618.creator: Yixing Lu, Zhaoxin Fan, Min Xu ✉
arxiv-2309-06618.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce a novel semi-supervised learning framework tailored for medical image segmentation. Central to our approach is the innovative Multi-scale Text-aware ViT-CNN Fusion scheme. This scheme adeptly combines the strengths of both ViTs and CNNs, capitalizing on the unique advantages of both architectures as well as the complementary information in vision-language modalities.

arxiv-2407-03458.title: Analysis of Iterative Deblurring: No Explicit Noise Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author Thanks: Paweł Danielewicz was supported by the U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science Grant No. DE-SC0019209.
arxiv-2407-03458.description: Abstract . Iterative deblurring, notably the Richardson-Lucy algorithm with and without regularization, is analyzed in the context of nuclear and high-energy physics applications. In these applications, probability distributions may be discretized into a few bins, measurement statistics can be high, and instrument performance can be well understood.

arxiv-2511-13011.title: Beyond Darkness: Thermal-Supervised 3D Gaussian Splatting for Low-Light Novel View Synthesis
arxiv-2511-13011.creator: Qingsen Ma, Chen Zou, Dianyun Wang, Jia Wang, Liuyu Xiang, Zhaofeng He
arxiv-2511-13011.description: Abstract Under extremely low-light conditions, novel view synthesis (NVS) faces severe degradation in terms of geometry, color consistency, and radiometric stability. Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipelines fail when applied directly to underexposed inputs, as independent enhancement across views causes illumination inconsistencies and geometric distortion.

arxiv-2512-13478.title: Non-Resolution Reasoning (NRR): A Computational Framework for Contextual Identity and Ambiguity Preservation
arxiv-2512-13478.creator: Kei Saito
arxiv-2512-13478.description: Abstract Current artificial intelligence systems, despite remarkable capabilities in text generation and pattern recognition, exhibit a fundamental architectural limitation: they resolve ambiguity prematurely. This premature semantic collapse—the tendency to collapse multiple valid interpretations into a single output—stems from classical identity assumptions embedded in standard neural architectures.

britannica-1911-whitelocke-bulstrode.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-whitelocke-bulstrode.description: Article 'Whitelocke, Bulstrode' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. and parliamentarian, eldest son of Sir James Whitelocke, was baptized on the 19th of August 1605, and educated at Merchant Taylors' School and at St John's College, Oxford, where he matriculated on the 8th of December 1620. He left Oxford, without a degree, for the Middle Temple, and was called to the bar in 1626 and chosen treasurer in 1628.

pmc-10670527.title: Exploring the Future of Cancer Impact in Alberta: Projections and Trends 2020–2040
pmc-10670527.creator: Darren R Brenner, Chantelle Carbonell, Dylan E O’Sullivan, Yibing Ruan, Robert B Basmadjian, Vickey Bu, Eliya Farah, Shaun K Loewen, Tara R Bond, Angela Estey, Anna Pujadas Botey, Paula J Robson
pmc-10670527.description: The impact of cancer in Alberta is expected to grow considerably, largely driven by population growth and aging. The Future of Cancer Impact (FOCI) initiative offers an overview of the present state of cancer care in Alberta and highlights potential opportunities for research and innovation across the continuum.

pmc-10673210.title: Research Progress in Tunable Fiber Lasers Based on Multimode Interference Filters
pmc-10673210.creator: Liqiang Zhang, Kexin Zhu, Yicun Yao, Xiuying Tian, Hailong Xu, Zhaogang Nie, Aiqun Liu
pmc-10673210.description: Tunable fiber lasers have the advantages of good beam quality, high integration, and adjustable output wavelength, and they are widely used in fields such as optical fiber communication and optical fiber sensing. The fiber filter is one of the key components of tunable fiber lasers.

pmc-11322221.title: The relationship between corona disease anxiety and sleep disturbances and suicidal ideation in medical staff: The mediating role of resiliency and cognitive flexibility: A cross‐sectional study
pmc-11322221.creator: Arya Haddadi, Nasrin Matinnia, Saeid Yazdi‐Ravandi
pmc-11322221.description: Background and AimsMedical staff have experienced anxiety, sleep disturbances, and suicide due to the COVID‐19 epidemic. Thus, this study examined the relationship between corona disease anxiety, sleep problems, and suicidal ideation in medical staff and how resiliency and cognitive flexibility mediate it.MethodsThis descriptive‐analytical cross‐sectional study examined medical staff.

pmc-11434137.title: Biosorption Ability of Pharmaceutically Active Compounds by Anabaena sp. and Chroococcidiopsis thermalis
pmc-11434137.creator: Jerzy Pogrzeba, Anna Poliwoda, Simone Morais
pmc-11434137.description: Drug overuse harms the biosphere, leading to disturbances in ecosystems’ functioning. Consequently, more and more actions are being taken to minimise the harmful impact of xenopharmaceuticals on the environment. One of the innovative solutions is using biosorbents—natural materials such as cells or biopolymers—to remove environmental pollutants; however, this focuses mainly on the removal of metal ions and colourants.

pmc-11577863.title: A novel mutation in the SLCO2A1 gene presenting as persistent hypoproteinaemia and refractory iron deficiency anaemia due to chronic enteropathy: a case report
pmc-11577863.creator: Sachith Mettananda, PKBUC Bandara, Manissha Rajeindran, Padmapani Padeniya
pmc-11577863.description: BackgroundThe SLCO2A1 gene encodes a prostaglandin transporter and we report a novel mutation causing hypoproteinaemia and refractory anaemia due to chronic enteropathy.Case presentationAn 18-year-old boy of consanguineous parents was investigated for hypoproteinaemia and anaemia. He was short, pale and had generalised oedema. Investigations revealed haemoglobin 5.8 g/dL; hypochromic microcytic anaemia; low serum protein, albumin, globulin, ferritin and iron.

pmc-11593146.title: Prealbumin Prognostic Score: A Novel Prognostic Indicator After Radical Gastrectomy in Patients with Gastric Cancer
pmc-11593146.creator: Ryota Matsui, Souya Nunobe, Motonari Ri, Rie Makuuchi, Tomoyuki Irino, Masaru Hayami, Manabu Ohashi, Takeshi Sano, Hidekazu Suzuki, Guido Alberto Massimo Tiberio
pmc-11593146.description: Simple SummaryThe Glasgow Prognostic Score and modified Glasgow Prognostic Score using a combination of serum albumin and C-reactive protein have been reported in relation to postoperative prognosis in many cancers. In recent years, prealbumin has often been used as an alternative to albumin, but the prognostic impact of prealbumin-based indices in the above-mentioned indices has not yet been reported.

pmc-11617442.title: Comparative Evaluation of Microleakage in Class II Composite Restorations Using Three Bulk-fill Composites with or without Resin-modified Glass Ionomer Cement Liner: A Stereomicroscopic Study
pmc-11617442.creator: Vijay Amarnath C Mundaragi, Nandini T Niranjan, Kusuma S Chandrashekhar, Dhanu G Rao, Thimmanagowda N Patil, Suvarna C Chavan
pmc-11617442.description: AimTo compare the microleakage of three bulk-fill composite resins with or without resin-modified glass ionomer cement (RMGIC) liner.Materials and methodsA total of 30 maxillary human 1st premolar teeth were selected. Two box preparations were made on the mesial and distal sides. Teeth were randomly divided into three groups of 10 teeth each.

pmc-12767162.title: Quantification of brominated flame retardants in soil
pmc-12767162.creator: Wojciech Jerzy Pietroń, Monika Baran, Marek Pajurek, Szczepan Mikołajczyk
pmc-12767162.description: IntroductionSoil quality plays a crucial role for farm animals, particularly those raised under free-range or organic conditions. Substances contaminating soil with a significant impact on food of animal origin are persistent organic pollutants (POPs). Recently, polybrominated diphenyl ethers (PBDEs) were included in this group.

pmc-13231721.title: AhR agonist Ficz modulates T follicular helper cells and ameliorates skin fibrosis in a bleomycin-induced SSc mouse model
pmc-13231721.creator: Xianzhong Zhu, Yulin Chen, Chuangye Qiu, Maoyun Wei, Junxian Chen, Baoxuan Luo, Qing Qi
pmc-13231721.description: ObjectivesT follicular helper (Tfh) cells are involved in the pathogenesis of systemic sclerosis (SSc). Recent investigations have revealed aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) regulated skin fibrosis in SSc. This study aims to explore the effect of AhR agonist Ficz on Tfh in a bleomycin (BLM)-induced SSc mouse model.

pmc-13477475.title: Annual-resolution evidence for aridity spikes at the onset of the Last Glacial Inception in an Eifel maar lake sediment
pmc-13477475.creator: Frank Sirocko, Frederik Krebsbach, Christian Forster, Frank Dreher, Martin Grosjean, Lucas Silva, Dana F. C. Riechelmann, Klemens Seelos, Ralf Schiebel
pmc-13477475.description: This study presents an annually laminated sediment record from the infilled maar lake at Hoher List in the Eifel volcanic field (Germany), documenting the “Last Glacial Inception” (LGI) at the end of the Eemian interglacial. The landscape of the late Eemian was dominated by a mixed forest containing Abies alba (silver fir).

pmc-13524353.title: Initial treatment for uncontrolled type 2 diabetes: A clinical trial comparing basal insulin and modified-release gliclazide
pmc-13524353.creator: Ebrahim Mohammadi, Laya Hooshmand Gharebagh, Maryam Hajiesmaello
pmc-13524353.description: Background:The global rise of type 2 diabetes (T2D) presents significant healthcare challenges in diagnosis, prevention, and treatment. This study compares basal insulin and modified-release gliclazide to assess their effectiveness in managing glycemic control and other clinical factors in T2D patients.
